segments.name: Payments
products: cross-border and in-country domestic payments and software solutions
segments.description: Provides a global payments platform and vertical-specific software that helps clients in education, healthcare, travel and business-to-business industries receive and reconcile payments.
segments.evidence: The Company has a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Clients pay Flywire for its secure global payments platform and vertical-specific software, which they use to receive reconciled domestic and international payments from their customers.
revenueModel.evidence: Flywire provides a secure global payments platform, offering its clients an innovative and streamlined process to receive reconciled domestic and international payments in a more cost effective and efficient manner.
